fullDescription: Frameless near-black footer with an acid-lime accent, four-column link grid, newsletter pill, and an edge-to-edge italic giant wordmark above the legal bar.
prompt: {"style": "Palette: ink #070707 page base, coal #0e0e0e raised surfaces (the meta strip and newsletter pill), acid-lime #d4ff3f as the single accent (buttons, hover, eyebrows, status dot) with a dimmer limeDim #a8cc2f, ash #8a8a82 for muted labels and fog #bdbdb5 for link text, white for headings. The giant wordmark uses a top-to-bottom lime gradient clipped to text (#e6ff5c -> #d4ff3f -> #b6e22f). Fonts (Google Fonts): Archivo for body/sans, Archivo Expanded (black 900 italic) for the wordmark and brand, JetBrains Mono for eyebrows, labels and legal text. Mood: confident, editorial, club-flyer energy. Accent treatment: lime pill buttons with arrow icons that flip to white on hover, lime tracking-wide uppercase mono eyebrows, faint lime ambient radial washes top and bottom, a subtle lime radial-dot grain overlay, and a lime drop-shadow glow under the wordmark.", "summary": "Build a frameless, full-bleed website footer on a near-black canvas with an acid-lime accent: a brand+newsletter meta strip, a four-column link grid, a single huge edge-to-edge italic wordmark, and a mono legal bar.", "special_notes": "Frameless and full-bleed: render only the footer section, no browser bar or device mockup. The giant wordmark must size to span the container width exactly (measure-and-scale, not a fixed font-size) and re-fit on resize and after fonts load. Keep all text WCAG-legible on the near-black ground (lime and fog/ash chosen for contrast). Use only this acid-lime-on-ink palette, no generic indigo or violet slop, no purple gradients. Keep accents to the single lime hue, lean on white/ash/fog for hierarchy, and preserve the faint grain and ambient washes for depth.", "layout_and_structure": "Frameless, full-width footer (no browser/device chrome), centered max-w 1380px inner container with px-6 (sm:px-10) gutters. From top: (1) a meta strip with brand lockup on the left and the newsletter on the right, separated below by a 7%-white hairline border; (2) a link grid of four columns (Product, Explore, Resources, Connect) with mono lime uppercase column headings; (3) the GIANT WORDMARK row, full-bleed inside the container, auto-sized via JS so the single italic word fits edge-to-edge exactly; (4) a legal bar topped by another faint hairline. Responsive reflow: desktop is brand-left / newsletter-right meta strip and a 4-column grid; tablet keeps the 4 columns but stacks meta items; mobile collapses links to 2 columns, stacks the meta strip and legal bar vertically, full-width newsletter input, and the wordmark re-fits smaller to its container; the ® superscript hides below sm.", "special_ui_components": ["Newsletter: a rounded-full coal pill labelled 'The Weekly Prompt' with a leading mail icon, an email input (placeholder you@studio.com), and a circular lime submit button with a right-arrow icon; the pill border turns lime on focus-within. Brand lockup: a rounded lime tile with a sparkles icon plus 'Promptpad' wordmark and a mono 'design, prompted' tagline. Connect column uses inline social icon links (Twitter/X, GitHub, Discord, YouTube). Link rows nudge right and turn lime on hover. Legal bar: mono copyright line plus Privacy / Terms / Status links and a live status pill with a pulsing lime dot reading 'All systems operational'. Hero of the footer is the oversized italic Archivo-Expanded wordmark with a lime gradient fill, glow, and a small ® superscript."]}
